messages.subject: a problem in transition to ggplot0.9 (bis)
parts:
Dear all,
yesterday, with the help of Brian, I solved a problem in reproducing a
plot using a group aesthetic:

----------------------------------------
library(MASS)
carsRidotto <- subset(Cars93, Passengers %in% 4:6)
ggp <- qplot(data= carsRidotto, Passengers, Price, geom="point",
group=Passengers)

ggp2 <- ggp + stat_sum_single(mean, shape=8, size=8)
ggp2 <- ggp2 + stat_sum_single(function(x) quantile(x, 0.1),
colour="orange", shape=17, size=7) +
stat_sum_single(function(x) quantile(x, 0.9), colour="orange",
shape=17, size=7)
ggp2 <- ggp2 + stat_sum_crossbar(function(x) quantile(x, 0.5),
function(x) quantile(x, 0.25),
function(x) quantile(x, 0.75),
geom="crossbar", colour="blue", width=0.5)
ggp2
----------------------------------------

It is essentialy a scatterplot on which I superimposed three different
boxplots for the different values of the Passengers variable.
Using such grouping aesthetic I am not more able to superimpose on the
same plot the quantile regression lines and the OLS line, using the
following code, as in the past version of ggplot:

----------------------------------------
ggp2 + stat_quantile(colour="blue", size=1, linetype=2) +
stat_quantile(colour="orange", size=1, linetype="twodash",
quantiles=c(0.1, 0.9)) +
stat_smooth(method=lm, se=FALSE, colour="red")
----------------------------------------

Sorry for this new request but I am trying to understand the news in
ggplot0.9 (and I would like to preserve at most the existing code).

Thanks again,
domenico
